name: Bubbles Public API
description: REST API for Bubbles, authenticated with personal access tokens (bbls_pat_…) or first-party OAuth 2.1 tokens. Read endpoints require the bubbles:read scope; the /v1/webhooks write surface requires webhooks:manage and POST /v1/meetings/join requires meetings:join (PATs carry every scope implicitly). Management endpoints (/v1/api-keys) use an app session token. Error responses share the envelope { "error": { "type", "message" } }.
